questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence: The city ______ build a new school last year.
questions.explanation: last year 表示过去时间，否定过去动作要用 did not + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: The city did not build a new school last year.

questions.prompt: There are ______ laptops for all the students. Many students still have no computer.
questions.explanation: 后句说许多学生仍没有电脑，说明笔记本电脑数量不足，因此用 not enough。
questions.evidence: There are not enough laptops for all the students.

questions.explanation: 比较两个地区电脑数量，用比较级 more...than。
questions.evidence: Northbank has more computers than Southfield.

questions.prompt: The council ______ publish the full report next June.
questions.explanation: next June 表示将来，用 will + 动词原形。
questions.evidence: The council will publish the full report next June.

questions.prompt: ______ the parents were happy with the plan. Some were, but some were not.
questions.explanation: 后句说有些家长满意，有些不满意，说明不是全部满意，用 Not all。
questions.evidence: Not all the parents were happy with the plan.

questions.explanation: 表示“仅仅在工作日运行”，用 only 强调限制。
questions.evidence: The minibus runs only on weekdays.

questions.prompt: Southfield’s attendance rate is ______ than Northbank’s.
questions.explanation: 比较两个出勤率，用比较级 lower...than。
questions.evidence: Southfield’s attendance rate is lower than Northbank’s.

questions.prompt: The council ______ promised to make the districts equal.
questions.explanation: 原文说“It did not promise to make the two districts equal.” 这里描述过去没有承诺，用 did not。
questions.evidence: The council did not promise to make the districts equal.

title: Who Gets the Desk? A Simulated Case Study of Unequal Access in Two School Districts · 规则与新语境练习
instructions: 先阅读本组中文规则与原句，区分新结构和已学规则，再完成独立句子；同一材料再次出现属于巩固，保持原ID。
passage:
在英语中，否定词（not, no, never）、比较结构（more than, less than, as...as）、数量限定词（some, any, enough, only, all, both）以及时态（过去、现在、将来）共同决定句子的准确含义。例如：'not enough' 表示数量不足；'only' 强调限制；'did not promise' 表示过去没有承诺；'will reduce' 表示将来会减少。理解这些词可以帮助我们判断一句话是肯定还是否定、是全部还是部分、是过去还是将来。

The council promised that the plan would reduce the average class size in Southfield to 30 within two years. It did not promise to make the two districts equal.
